objective: Admit provenance-bound candidate narrative observations into the qualified STEP-001 state without retaining manuscript text, inventing certainty, or converting model confidence into literary truth.

source_binding.rule: Every materialization request is bound to one exact authorized source digest. Candidate records cannot override that binding.

rules: Every candidate must cite at least one valid source anchor.
VERIFIED/OBSERVED evidence may support ASSERTED claims only above the asserted confidence floor.
INFERRED evidence may support ASSERTED claims only above the stricter inferred floor and with at least two distinct evidence families.
CONTESTED evidence cannot materialize as ASSERTED; it must be ALTERNATIVE or UNRESOLVED.
Conflicting interpretations must remain explicit alternatives/unresolved claims; the materializer never silently picks a winner.
Duplicate entity/event IDs merge only anchors and non-conflicting tags; contradictory identity payloads fail closed.
Duplicate claims merge provenance and evidence-family metadata but confidence is max-observed, never summed or vote-inflated.
Materialized state must pass the STEP-001 validator before PASS.
No claim type may encode literary quality, defect status, author intent, or a revision instruction.
Empty or insufficient evidence may produce a valid sparse state and a receipt with rejected candidates; it must not invent missing facts.
promotion_boundary: PASS proves deterministic admission/validation behavior only. It does not establish that model-extracted narrative claims are factually correct without source-grounded evaluation.
